messages:
maria: Quick rollcall for tomorrow's release train (10:00-12:00 PT). Who's pushing which service and who is doing smoke checks? Drop your window + rollback command.

aj: I'll be doing inference-runtime (10:15-10:30). Smoke owner: me. Rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/inference-runtime -n prod`. Plan to canary 10% for 5m then ramp.

sunil: Serving-config changes from my side (10:40-10:50). Smoke owner: @leah can you take the smoke for config? Rollback is PR revert + redeploy.

leah: Yep I can smoke serve-config. I'll run the checklist and post results. ETA 10:55 for completion.

tim: UI webapp deploy (11:05-11:20). Smoke: @maria if you can verify the auth flow. Rollback: switch traffic to blue with `svctl traffic set ui blue`.

ops-oncall: Heads up — I'll monitor infra alerts and watch for increased error rate during the windows. If p95 token latency goes >500ms for >3m, we trigger rollback.

deploy-bot: Pipeline status: inference-runtime build passed, serving-config awaiting approval, ui webapp queued.

maria: Nice. @aj please attach the smoke steps you'll run. Also confirm any DB migrations?

aj: No db migrations. Smoke steps (quick):
```
1) curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.prod.example.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq .id
2) run 50 requests over 60s with ab or vegeta to ensure 200s
3) check logs for OOM / KV-cache errors
```
If any step fails -> rollback.

sunil: serving-config has a minor config flag change only (no schema). I'll push PR now.

leah: I'll create a small runbook snippet in #incidents in case we need to escalate: short commands + contacts.

maria: Perfect. Final checklist for everyone: paste your deploy manifest link or pipeline id here, and add 2nd smoke contact if you have one. I'll assemble a single runbook before 09:00 PT. :thumbsup:

aj: pipeline id: 7865123, secondary smoke: @tim.

sunil: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/serving-config/pulls/412, secondary smoke: @maria.

tim: pipeline id: 7865140, secondary smoke: @aj.

maria: Great — thanks team. I'll post the one-pager by 09:00 and ping the oncall at T-10m.

ops-oncall: Copy. I'll be on standby and will post any anomalies to this thread.

deploy-bot: Reminder: set deploy tag `release/train-2026-03-18` on all pipelines before starting.
